rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying something is very good or wonderful.

example.english: The desserts at this restaurant are fabulous.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳啲甜品真係正。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tim4 ban2 zan1 hai6 zeng3

rows.note: Use this when “fabulous” means marvelous, extraordinary, or seemingly incredible rather than simply very good.

example.english: This tiny camera can take such beautiful pictures—it’s fabulous.
example.traditional: 呢部機咁細部，竟然可以影到咁靚，真係神奇。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 gam3 sai3 bou6 ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 jing2 dou3 gam3 leng3 zan1 hai6 san4 kei4

rows.note: Use this for someone or something that is stylish, fashionable, or glamorous in appearance.

example.english: They look fabulous in that leather jacket.
example.traditional: 佢着住件皮褸行入嚟，真係好有型。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 pei2 lau1 haang4 jap6 lai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 jing4
